keys.description: Name of the court that issued THIS decision, exactly as written: the court named in the document's heading and in its signature line. Do NOT use a court that is only mentioned in the text as an earlier, lower or higher instance.
The date on which this decision was issued (the date of the judgment, usually in the signature line at the end).

The kind of court document. judgment = a final decision on the merits (ítélet); partial_judgment = a decision on part of the claims (részítélet); interim_judgment = a preliminary decision on a point of principle (közbenső ítélet); order = a procedural or non-merits decision (végzés); other = anything else. The kind is normally stated in the document's heading in capital letters (for example ÍTÉLETET, RÉSZÍTÉLETET, KÖZBENSŐ ÍTÉLETET, VÉGZÉST): decide by that heading, not by words elsewhere in the text.
